message.content: During the community meeting held on March 6th, Li Hua suggested adding more seating areas to the garden to make it more inviting and comfortable for visitors. Additionally, she proposed including flower beds with native plants, which would not only enhance the aesthetic appeal but also attract more butterflies and bees due to their beneficial role in pollination. Furthermore, Li Hua suggested adding a small herb section to the garden, providing visitors with the opportunity to pick fresh herbs for their culinary needs. These suggestions were aimed at creating a functional and enjoyable space for the community garden.
